LanguageData.DMSAC_PatrolSquadDesc: A patrol squad has reached the facility. Follow-up units will arrive in shorter intervals now.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Huntdown_LetterText: The automatroid division has logged your colony as a target for liquidation. Command listed every incursion into its facilities on the broadcast, and announced that its units have left patrol rotation.\n\nFirst comes the warning. Then comes the corps.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Huntdown_AlertLabel: Huntdown: the first wave is coming
LanguageData.DMSAC_Huntdown_AlertCritical: Huntdown: troops on the strike lane
LanguageData.DMSAC_Huntdown_AlertDesc: At DEFCON 5 the division has fixed on this colony. Its first wave is assembling and will arrive when the countdown ends.
LanguageData.DMSAC_Huntdown_AlertCriticalDesc: The huntdown wave is on the strike lane and can appear at the map edge at any moment.
